_preset: The default search: a multi-generation hill-climb from a seed config. For a wide one-shot sampling run instead, use fan_search.json.
_sections: Three groups: vision (how images become vectors), scoring (what a good one looks like) and search (how many, and how they breed). Only vision is part of the embedding cache key -- change one of those and the folder is re-embedded; change anything in scoring and a re-score is free. A file with vision and scoring but NO search block can create embeddings and re-score, but the Run search button stays greyed.

vision._clip_model: B32 (default, ~600MB, fast) | L14 (~1.7GB, better separation) | SO400M (SigLIP at 384px, ~3.5GB, strongest on text and slowest). Scores from two models are NOT comparable -- different vector spaces. Switching re-embeds the folder once, then caches per model, so switching back is instant.
vision._seed_lives_here: seed and crop_frac look like search knobs and are not: both are in the cache key. Moving either into the search block would default it and orphan every embedding made with the other value.

scoring._objective: PICK ONE: reference_dir OR captions. Setting both is a config error -- with two objectives a result cannot be attributed to either. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the loader (JSON has no comments).
scoring._reference_dir_example: Set this to a folder of images to search toward instead of a caption, and set captions to [].
negative_captions: a dense field of small dots
a single bright point right in the middle
